scope: Implemented directly on main at the human request. No customer data cleanup or migration.
changes: Use in stores enables missing-product addition from the product-card action; price changes remain opt-in.
Explicit per-store restoration is included in the signed preview and atomic apply; existing product ID, source ownership, stock, history, local prices and disabled-source rules are retained.
Authorized managers can restore received cards in their stores without turning them into local source products.
The review shows SKU, recorded stock, hidden/disconnected/available states and explicit restoration count; mobile review scrolls into view.
Archive conflicts use a SKU-based recovery link that clears unrelated filters; access-denied matches show an explanation.
Administrator-only global deletion has a read-only dependency review, all linked stores, separate confirmation, expiring scope-bound signature and idempotent retries.
Deletion rechecks history and balances under transaction locks; safely removes unused catalog memberships, grants and fixed selections, retaining unrelated products and audit evidence.
Committed deletion invalidates catalog/API caches and notifies affected stores; notification failure cannot undo a committed operation.
Movement print signatures and nonmonetary totals are compact. Monetary totals retain their prior width.
Russian, Kyrgyz and English strings and the existing shared-catalog guide are updated.
preserved: Existing icon-only row actions and mobile equivalents
Permissions, plan gates, zero/local prices, currency handling
No automatic duplicate merge, stock correction, price synchronization or removal of recorded history
Existing pending preparation requests and API callers retain safe compatibility
